part.text:
Fixed the result-level cache bug in `processing/src/main/java/org/apache/druid/query/groupby/ResultRow.java:170`.

The post-aggregator restore loop never advanced its position, so each cached post-aggregate value overwrote the first post-aggregate slot. Added `postPos++`.

Validated with `GroupByQueryQueryToolChestTest`: 20 tests run, 0 failures.
